hero.headline: THE SITE SHOULD WORK FOR EVERYONE.
hero.subheadline: Distilled Core aims to provide an accessible path to company information and connected resources.

content.lead: People should be able to operate core navigation, understand page content and follow links without relying exclusively on a mouse or visual styling.

sections.heading: THE REALITY
sections.body: People should be able to operate core navigation, understand page content and follow links without relying exclusively on a mouse or visual styling.

sections.heading: HOW TO APPROACH IT
sections.body: Implement semantic HTML, keyboard navigation, focus visibility, readable contrast, reduced-motion support and usable form handoffs. Test and document issues rather than claiming a formal certification.

sections.heading: YOUR NEXT MOVE
sections.body: If a page or connected experience creates an access problem, use the general contact channel to describe the issue and relevant URL.
